modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fontsys: Use any font installed on your computer for all in-game text.
fontsys.pack.title: Fontsys
fontsys.screen.title: Fontsys
fontsys.screen.show_hidden.tooltip: Also lists fonts that are hidden because they can't draw Minecraft's text well: fonts without Latin letters, color emoji fonts, unsupported font types and the computer's own private fonts. A tag says why each one is hidden.
fontsys.screen.size.tooltip: How big the text is. At 10, most fonts are about as tall as Minecraft's own letters. The preview shows the next size down and up; click one to use it.
fontsys.screen.oversample.tooltip: How finely letters are drawn. Higher looks sharper and uses a little more memory. Auto matches your GUI scale, which suits most screens.
fontsys.screen.shift_x.tooltip: Moves the letters right, or left below 0, in GUI pixels. Most fonts need 0.
fontsys.screen.shift_y.tooltip: Moves the letters down, or up below 0, in GUI pixels. Use it if text sits too high or too low on buttons. Most fonts need 0.
fontsys.screen.apply_to_uniform.tooltip: Minecraft switches to a separate Unicode font when Force Unicode Font is on (Options > Language > Font Settings). Turn this on to use your font there too. Leave it off to keep Minecraft's Unicode font for that setting.
fontsys.screen.crisp.tooltip: Hard-edged pixels with no smoothing, for pixel-style fonts. While this is on, sharpness follows the GUI scale.
fontsys.screen.reset.tooltip: Switches back to Minecraft's own font. Your font and settings stay selected here, so Apply brings them back.
fontsys.screen.rescan.tooltip: Looks for fonts again. Use it after installing fonts, or adding them to the fonts folder, while the game is running.
fontsys.screen.open_folder.tooltip: Opens this instance's fonts folder. Fonts you put there are listed only in this instance, without installing them on your computer. You can also drag font files onto this screen.
fontsys.unapplied.title: Apply your changes?
fontsys.unapplied.message: You changed the font settings but haven't applied them.
fontsys.preview.empty: Pick a font on the left to preview it here.
fontsys.preview.error: This font can't be previewed. Applying it would fall back to the vanilla font.
fontsys.preview.pangram: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
fontsys.preview.chat: <Steve> Nice font! Want to go mining?
fontsys.preview.pixel_font.crisp: Looks like a pixel font: try Crisp edges.
fontsys.preview.pixel_font.crisp_size: Looks like a pixel font: try Crisp edges at size %s.
fontsys.preview.pixel_font.size: Pixel font: size %s keeps every pixel square.
fontsys.confirm.title: Keep this font?
fontsys.confirm.sample: This is your new font. Can you read it easily?
fontsys.status.no_fonts: No fonts were found on this computer.
fontsys.status.flatpak: No fonts found: this launcher runs in a Flatpak sandbox that hides your system fonts. Give it access to /usr/share/fonts and ~/.local/share/fonts (for example with Flatseal).
fontsys.status.unsupported_os: Font discovery isn't supported on this operating system.
fontsys.status.load_failed: %s couldn't be loaded; using the vanilla font. See the game log.
fontsys.toast.conflict.title: Fontsys is turned off
fontsys.toast.conflict.message: %s also changes the game font. Remove one of the two mods.
fontsys.conflict.banner: Fontsys is turned off because %s also changes the game font. Remove one of the two mods and restart the game. If you keep Fontsys, you can pick the same font here by searching for it.
fontsys.drop.title: Fonts added
fontsys.drop.added: Copied to this instance's fonts folder: %s
fontsys.drop.added_skipped: Copied to the fonts folder: %s. Skipped (not a font, or already there): %s
fontsys.drop.none: Skipped (not a font, or already in the fonts folder): %s
fontsys.options.button.tooltip: Use any font installed on your computer for all in-game text.
fontsys.command.fonts.header: %s matching families (%s shown in the font list):
fontsys.command.fonts.more: …and %s more. Add a filter to narrow the list.
